description.en: Halid Bešlić’s U meni jesen je, arranged for five voices and sung a cappella by Voxford, a cappella group from Zagreb, Croatia.
description.hr: Pjesma Halida Bešlića U meni jesen je u aranžmanu za pet glasova, a cappella izvedba Voxforda, skupine iz Zagreba.

source: Recorded October 2025: the exported video file (~/Downloads/voxford-top-videos, 2025-10-08) and Ante's audio mix 'U meni jesen je.wav' on Drive (2025-10-08) agree (checked in ticket F, 2026-11-10); song identified from its audio and the TikToks audio mixes on Drive (brand/mediji-inventar.md); song credit Halid Bešlić per its Apple Music listing
